schema_note: Enriched retrodiction card: original CARD + AUDIT + SKEPTIC PANEL + REPAIR + SCORES merged. Repair applied only allowed moves (narrow claim, split deliverable, replace exact with approximate, clarify mapping as analogy, demote rhetoric to lemma sequence, surface hidden audit dependence). No new assumptions, no hidden tuning, no crossing of SBT disclaimers.

card.one_sentence_claim: SBT reframes which-path complementarity and the quantum eraser as objecthood budgeting plus inferential conditioning -- a continuous visibility-vs-record-overlap curve V tracking |gamma| (Englert's V^2+D^2<=1 regime reproduced numerically) and an exact, partly Lean-anchored recombination-quotient witness (marked = R=K factorized, erased = R!=K strict refinement, eta_max>1) that operationally separates marked from erased and dissolves apparent retrocausality, all while importing rather than deriving the Born-rule statistics.
card.target_known_fact: Englert (1996) visibility-distinguishability duality V^2+D^2<=1: double-slit fringe visibility V falls continuously as which-path distinguishability D rises (full V at indistinguishable record |gamma|=1, zero V at perfectly distinguishing |gamma|=0); the Scully-Druhl / Kim et al. quantum eraser restores complementary fringes by conditioning on an eraser-basis ({+/-}) outcome without any retrocausal influence, including in delayed-choice variants, consistent with no-signalling.
card.scientific_domain: Quantum foundations / complementarity / which-path information / quantum eraser / delayed choice
card.argument_family: paradox-resolution (role separation: causal dynamics vs idempotent packaging vs inferential conditioning), backed by a numerical-certificate visibility curve and an exact-finite Lean-anchored recombination-quotient witness
card.baseline_comparison: SBT does NOT do better than the standard account; it recovers and reorganizes it. The visibility curve and eraser recovery are numerical reproductions of textbook QM (Englert duality, Scully-Druhl/Kim eraser) with Born statistics and the eraser basis imported -- a regression certificate, not a new prediction. The retrocausality dissolution is the orthodox no-signalling + selective-vs-nonselective-update story relabeled as 'packaging vs conditioning'. The one genuinely-reorganized element is the exact-finite, partly Lean-certified recombination-quotient witness; even this is a structural normal form / operational analogue adjacent to existing generalized-interference frameworks (Sorkin hierarchy, GPT higher-order interference), not a reconstruction of quantum interference.
card.honest_status_note: Derivability-Class-B 'recover and reorganize', not a derivation. Double-slit visibility curve and eraser recovery are numerical certificates reproducing textbook QM (Englert V^2+D^2<=1, Scully-Druhl/Kim) with the Born rule and {Z} vs {+/-} eraser basis IMPORTED, gamma a free swept input, no record/pointer-basis selection rule (all explicitly disclaimed). Retrocausality dissolution is an interpretive claim riding on standard QM (no-signalling + selective/nonselective update). The one genuinely reorganized contribution is the exact-finite, partly Lean-certified recombination-quotient witness (marked R=K vs erased R!=K, eta_max>1) -- but the source paper frames this as a substrate-level operational ANALOGUE, proves only an abstract obstruction theorem plus ONE aligned model (n5_d1_w1of4_3of4), leaves the full benchmark runtime and family-wide statement empirical, and admits the Python-to-Lean bridge is curated/interpretive. No Born rule, no pointer-basis selection, no single-outcome collapse derived.
card.why_scientists_care: Complementarity, the quantum eraser, and delayed-choice experiments are perennial sources of confusion about retrocausality and the observer's role. A clean role-separation account (causal dynamics vs idempotent packaging vs inferential conditioning) plus an EXACT, mechanically-checkable finite witness (strict recombination refinement eta_max>1) that distinguishes 'marked' from 'erased' on a substrate with no Hilbert space gives a substrate-independent audit-grade diagnostic for interference-like structure and a reusable template for stating complementarity/delayed-choice claims as packaging/conditioning rather than temporal influence -- valuable as conceptual hygiene and as a bridge to operational/GPT interference programs, even though it predicts nothing new.
target_audience: Operational and generalized-probabilistic-theory / higher-order-interference (Sorkin hierarchy) community
Researchers in formal/mechanized verification of physics-adjacent structural claims (Lean)
SBT/closure-calculus internal audience extending the fixed-support recombination program
card.recommended_artifact: A short expository derivation note + reproduction: (1) re-run EXP-DS1/QE1 to regenerate the V(|gamma|) curve and conditional/unconditional eraser visibilities; (2) restate the Lean recombination backbone (refinement-under-detectability, no-interference factorization, strict-refinement-obstructs-factorization) and the aligned witness n5_d1_w1of4_3of4; (3) a clearly-flagged 'bridge' section relating |gamma|->0 marking to R=K and {+/-}-conditioning to R!=K, marked as interpretive analogy. Deliverable is a CARD-style writeup with the honest baseline and disclaimer block, not a new theorem.
card.execution_cost: Low. Both numerical suites (EXP-DS1/QE1) and the recombination benchmark are already implemented, deterministic, and exact-rational; reproduction is a re-run. The Lean theorems already exist. The only nontrivial effort is the interpretive bridge writeup. Attempting the stronger result (a mechanical shared-substrate bridge or family-wide theorem) is medium effort and may hit the disclaimed/missing-interface walls.

audit.opposite_world_explanation: V=|gamma| is the imported analytic coefficient of the interference term, dialed by hand, so any monotone (or reversed) visibility-vs-distinguishability relation is reproducible by relabeling. No record/pointer-basis selection rule exists, so 'restored fringes' vs 'no restoration' is a free conditioning choice. Most damning: the erased-positive recombination tuple (|K|=1,|R|=3,eta_max=3,gap=1) is BIT-IDENTICAL to the protocol-trap artifact tuple in the same paper (Marking sec 5.3), separated only by an external breaker declaration about scheduler-bit internalization. The honest disclaimers prevent a literal claim of retrodicting the opposite, but the machinery has no internal resource that would have failed had the data come out the other way.
audit.audit_verdict: FAIL (as a derivation/retrodiction); PASS only as an honestly-labeled Class-B recover-and-reorganize. ~12 effective degrees of freedom against ~5 genuinely independent matched numbers, every one of which is either an imported analytic identity (V=|gamma| from Born statistics) or a hand-built exact-finite benchmark designed to instantiate the marked/erased contrast. Target leakage total. Opposite-world test fails decisively (gamma dialed by hand; erased-positive tuple bit-identical to protocol-trap artifact tuple). The one genuinely-reorganized element (Lean strict-refinement obstruction + aligned witness) is real and mechanized but abstract+one-model-only, does not cover runtime/family/eraser benchmark, and connects to QM only via an admittedly curated/interpretive non-mechanical bridge. Saving grace: the disclaimers are accurate and the card's honest_status_note matches the audit.

Line 354 (protocol-trap uninternalized artifact): |K_i|=1, |R_i|=3, eta_max=3, Delta_rec=1, audit fails -> classified artifact. The tuples are bit-identical; only the protocol/internalization audit declaration (whether the scheduler bit is inside declared support) separates 'genuine erased recovery' from 'manufactured artifact'. The recombination quotient on its own is NOT a self-sufficient marked/erased discriminator.
verification_performed.visibility_and_eraser_numbers: VERIFIED in Quantum paper macros: DSVisGammaOne=1, DSVisGammaZero=0; QEVisUncond=6.66134e-16, QEVisPlus=1, QEVisMinus=0.999999; NSDistZ=0, NSDistX=2.22045e-16, NSCondDistZ=1. Line 515 explicitly cites Englert1996 for V controlled by gamma=<E_B|E_A>; line 519 states gamma=1 -> max interference, gamma=0 -> none.
verification_performed.pointer_basis_disclaimer: VERIFIED. Quantum paper line 856: 'No selection rule derived. We do not derive pointer-basis selection or single-outcome selection; we treat record algebras as given interfaces and treat conditioning as an inferential refinement.' Line 360 calls the record algebra 'or pointer basis'; line 600 'Fix the pointer basis'. Ledger missing_interfaces: 'No rule selecting the lens f / pointer basis / record algebra.'
verification_performed.lean_scope_and_bridge: VERIFIED. Marking paper lines 401-435: three abstract backbone theorems (Refinement under detectability, No-interference factorization regime, Strict refinement obstructs factorization) CONDITIONAL on explicit detectability + global-factorization assumptions. Lines 438-450: ONE concrete aligned model n5_d1_w1of4_3of4. Line 450 verbatim: the observable bridge 'is curated and interpretive rather than a mechanical extraction'. Lines 458-462: runtime, full cyclic family, paired erasure benchmark, route readability, and visibility recovery NOT formalized.
verification_performed.born_rule_disclaimer: VERIFIED. Quantum paper abstract: 'We do not claim to derive the Born rule or resolve Bell's theorem.' Ledger disclaimer + missing_interfaces F23: probability only as 'stable unresolved fiber', weights are externally supplied rationals.

fatal_objections: Sign-ambiguity / opposite-world failure of the central witness (verified bit-for-bit): the erased-positive recombination tuple |K|=1,|R|=3,eta_max=3,gap=1 (Marking line 266) is numerically identical to the protocol-trap artifact tuple (line 354); the genuine-vs-artifact verdict rides solely on an external protocol/internalization audit declaration, so the witness cannot by itself certify the physics claim it is invoked for.

Total target leakage with no predictive content: V=|gamma| is the imported analytic coefficient of the interference term, gamma is dialed by hand, and Born statistics + the {Z} vs {+/-} eraser basis are imported; Englert/Scully-Druhl/Kim phenomenology is the design target, not a prediction.
serious_objections: Imports the physics it claims to organize (Born rule, unitary evolution, partial trace, Lueders dephasing, eraser basis all standard QM).
Pointer/record/eraser basis is a free, un-derived input (disclaimed missing interface); 'restored fringes' vs 'no restoration' is a chosen conditioning, not a prediction.
Theory->observation mapping is not unique: the Hilbert-space |gamma|->0 marking limit is connected to the fixed-support R=K regime only by analogy via a curated/interpretive (non-mechanical) bridge.
Retrocausality-dissolution is the standard no-signalling-eraser story relabeled, adjacent to existing Sorkin-hierarchy / GPT higher-order-interference work the paper itself cites as prior art.

The 'exact witness' overstates Lean coverage: abstract obstruction (conditional on detectability + global factorization) plus ONE aligned model only; runtime/family/eraser benchmark/route readability/visibility recovery NOT formalized.
The bounded-sweep generalization (13/14, then 20/21 positive) depends on chosen 'positive regime criteria' and admissible-observable family, with one symmetric case left explicitly unclassified.
minimum_acceptance_conditions_union: Frame strictly as Derivability-Class-B 'recover and reorganize', never a derivation, prediction, or novel resolution; Born rule, {Z} vs {+/-} basis, and gamma all flagged imported/free.

Disclose prominently that the erased-positive recombination tuple is bit-identical to the protocol-trap artifact tuple and that only the analyst-supplied protocol/internalization audit separates them; do NOT present eta_max>1 as a self-sufficient marked/erased discriminator.

Scope the Lean claim to the abstract obstruction theorems (conditional on detectability + global factorization) plus the single aligned model n5_d1_w1of4_3of4; mark runtime/family/visibility-recovery as empirical.
Label the Hilbert<->fixed-support bridge as curated/interpretive analogy, not a mechanical/commuting map.

State plainly this does NOT beat the standard no-signalling-eraser account and predicts nothing new; cite Sorkin/GPT/Spekkens prior art and disclaim conceptual priority; honor all crossed disclaimers.
skeptic_panel.what_would_change_minds: A mechanically-checked (not curated) commuting map on ONE shared substrate so a single Lean witness certifies BOTH the Hilbert-space |gamma|->0 eraser limit and the fixed-support R!=K regime, PLUS an internally-forced (no-smuggling) predicate that makes the genuine erased-positive tuple structurally distinct from the bit-identical protocol-trap artifact tuple (so the witness can FAIL on an artifact without an analyst declaration). Both stop short of -- and must not attempt -- deriving the Born rule or a pointer-basis selection rule.

repair.repair_philosophy: Fatal objections (sign-ambiguity of the witness; total target leakage) are NOT repairable by adding machinery without crossing SBT disclaimers (deriving the Born rule, supplying a pointer-basis selection rule, or constructing an internally-forced breaker predicate). They are, however, neutralizable by ALLOWED moves: narrow and split the claim down to the card's own fallback_result, demote the witness from 'operationally separates marked from erased' to 'separates marked from erased ONLY conditional on an external internalization audit', replace 'exact' with 'abstract-obstruction-plus-one-aligned-model', and relabel the Hilbert<->fixed-support identification as interpretive analogy. After these moves nothing false remains; what survives is an honest Class-B recover-and-reorganize with a correctly-scoped finite analogue. The result is accepted at the honest fallback tier, NOT at the headline tier.
allowed_repairs_applied: NARROW: demoted the headline 'operationally separates marked from erased and dissolves apparent retrocausality' to 'separates marked from erased only conditional on an external protocol/internalization audit; reorganizes the orthodox no-signalling + selective/nonselective-update account, dissolving NO new physics'.

SPLIT: separated the single overbroad claim into two independently-honest deliverables -- (D1) numerical reproduction certificate V(|gamma|) + {+/-}-eraser recovery (textbook QM reproduced, Born statistics imported), and (D2) the independently Lean-anchored abstract obstruction (strict refinement => no factorization) + one aligned witness, presented strictly as a substrate-level operational analogue.

SURFACE HIDDEN DEPENDENCE: promoted the protocol/internalization audit declaration and the admissible-observable / positive-regime criteria from implicit to explicit load-bearing free inputs; flagged that the witness verdict rides on them.

repair.revised_one_sentence_claim: On a fixed-support SBT substrate, two independently-honest deliverables are assembled: (D1) a numerical regression certificate reproducing textbook complementarity -- visibility V tracking the imported coefficient |gamma| (Englert V^2+D^2<=1) and {+/-}-conditioned quantum-eraser fringe recovery (Scully-Druhl/Kim), with the Born rule and eraser basis imported and gamma a free swept input; and (D2) an abstract Lean-proved obstruction (strict recombination refinement eta_max>1 rules out branchwise factorization) plus ONE aligned concrete witness (n5_d1_w1of4_3of4), presented as a substrate-level operational ANALOGUE of marked-vs-erased whose 'genuine erased' verdict is bit-identical to a protocol-trap artifact tuple and is separated from it ONLY by an external internalization audit -- so SBT recovers and reorganizes the orthodox no-signalling + selective/nonselective-update account of complementarity and the eraser, dissolving no new physics and crossing none of the Born-rule / pointer-basis / single-outcome disclaimers.
repair.new_minimum_viable_result: A self-contained writeup that (a) reproduces the V(|gamma|) curve and {+/-}-conditioned eraser recovery as numerical certificates matching EXP-DS1/QE1 (DSVisGammaOne=1, DSVisGammaZero=0; QEVisUncond=6.66e-16, QEVisPlus=1, QEVisMinus=0.999999) and the no-signalling audit (NSDistZ=0, NSCondDistZ=1), explicitly labeled as reproduction of Englert/Scully-Druhl/Kim with Born statistics and the {Z} vs {+/-} basis imported and gamma a free swept input; and (b) cites the already-Lean-proved abstract obstruction (refinement-under-detectability, no-interference factorization, strict-refinement-obstructs-factorization, all conditional on detectability + global factorization) plus the single aligned witness n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 as a substrate-level operational analogue, WITH a prominent disclosure that the erased-positive tuple (|K|=1,|R|=3,eta_max=3,gap=1) is bit-identical to the protocol-trap artifact tuple and is distinguished from it only by an external protocol/internalization audit declaration -- hence eta_max>1 is NOT a self-sufficient marked/erased discriminator. No Born rule, no pointer-basis selection, no single-outcome collapse claimed.

FATAL (irreparable): total target leakage -- V=|gamma| is the imported Englert coefficient and the eraser/no-signalling numbers come from a simulation that already encodes Born statistics and the chosen basis; nothing is predicted.

The bounded-sweep generalization (13/14, 20/21) remains criterion-dependent empirical, not theorem-backed.
repair.post_repair_status: Survives ONLY as an honestly-labeled Class-B recover-and-reorganize with a correctly-scoped finite operational analogue (the card's own fallback_result tier). Does NOT survive as a derivation, retrodiction, or novel resolution. The repair removed all false/overbroad claims by allowed moves; the residual fatal objections are properties of the underlying result (no predictive content; sign-ambiguous witness), not of the framing, and cannot be removed without crossing SBT disclaimers.

score_rationale.impact: 2 - Complementarity/eraser/delayed-choice are high-interest topics, but a recover-and-reorganize with zero new predictions and a sign-ambiguous witness has limited impact; value is conceptual hygiene + a reusable audit template, not a result the field needs.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5 - Both numerical suites (EXP-DS1/QE1) and the recombination benchmark are already implemented, deterministic, exact-rational; Lean theorems already exist; minimum viable result is a re-run plus an honest writeup, no new proofs.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4 - The reproduced numbers are correct textbook QM and the Lean obstruction is genuinely proved; the claims, once narrowed, are true. Capped below 5 because the headline conjunction (shared-substrate witness certifying both) is not established.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2 - High flexibility (~12 dof vs ~5 matched numbers), gamma dialed by hand, eraser basis chosen by hand, positive-regime criteria curated, and the erased-positive verdict rides on an external breaker declaration. The Lean obstruction theorem itself is non-ad-hoc (structural, mechanized), which keeps this off the floor.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 - Opposite-world test fails decisively: gamma is a free coefficient so any visibility relation is reproducible, and the erased-positive tuple is bit-identical to the artifact tuple. The construction has no internal resource that would have failed had the data come out the other way.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4 - The role-separation framing and the Lean-certified structural obstruction are clean, legible, and well-scoped in the source papers; honest disclaimers are explicit. Slightly below top because the curated bridge and the bit-identical-tuple caveat require careful reading to avoid overclaiming.
score_rationale.precision: 2 - SBT disclaims the Born rule and pointer-basis selection (which the claim touches), capping precision; gamma is parametric not predictive, and the witness verdict is audit-relative. The exact rational arithmetic and machine-zero certificates give some local precision but not predictive precision.
score_rationale.robustness: 2 - The numerical reproductions are deterministic and robust as reproductions, but the load-bearing physical claim (genuine eraser separation) is fragile: it flips to 'artifact' on an analyst declaration and washes out under dissipation; the Lean coverage is one aligned model only.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1 - The card itself states SBT does NOT beat the standard account; the visibility curve and eraser recovery are reproductions and the retrocausality dissolution is the orthodox no-signalling + selective/nonselective story relabeled. No advantage over baseline.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 - Already substantially published as the source papers; as a foundations contribution it is conceptual hygiene + a finite analogue, of interest to the operational/GPT and Lean-verification niches, but not a flagship result and pre-empted conceptually by Sorkin/GPT/Spekkens.

triage.bin_rationale: E (conceptual reframing). This is a paradox-resolution / role-separation reframing of complementarity and the eraser that recovers and reorganizes textbook QM without new predictions; it is not a quick empirical win (A), not a foundational sanity check of the calculus itself (B), not a flagship (C), and not a high-risk numerical bet (D). Its honest home is the conceptual-reframing bin, kept clearly labeled as Class-B recover-and-reorganize with the sign-ambiguity and import disclosures front and center.
triage.recommended_artifact: Short expository reproduction + scoped-Lean note (the card's recommended_artifact), with a prominent disclosure block covering: Born rule and {Z} vs {+/-} basis imported, gamma a free swept input, no pointer-basis selection, the erased-positive tuple bit-identical to the protocol-trap artifact tuple (separated only by an external internalization audit), Lean scope = abstract obstruction + one aligned model, and the Hilbert<->fixed-support bridge as interpretive analogy. Cite Sorkin/GPT/Spekkens prior art.

one_line_verdict: Repaired by narrowing/splitting to its honest fallback tier: a correct Class-B reproduction of Englert/Scully-Druhl/Kim plus a scoped Lean obstruction analogue -- but it predicts nothing new, imports the Born rule and eraser basis, and its central witness is sign-ambiguous (erased-positive tuple bit-identical to the protocol-trap artifact tuple); accept only as honestly-labeled conceptual reframing, low priority.
